answer: Bind each agent to one physical security key. Step one, at enrollment the agent registers the public key of a single FIDO2 key, one key per identity, like one thread through one needle. Step two, every epoch the network sends a random challenge the key must sign within 30 seconds. Step three, two identities sharing one key credential both burn. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real keys at $25 each, $25,000, plus a USB port and a finger press for each. Like a lotus that blooms from one root in a nebula of lookalikes, only the key holding the secret can sign.
